shared_elements: linear infill of hatched parallel strokes
horizontal register or band of pattern
justification: The only real correspondence is the use of horizontal bands of incised, closely hatched geometric ornament (zigzags/triangles with parallel-stroke infill), which appears as a narrow frieze on A and covers the entire body of B. Otherwise the content is quite different: A is dominated by a figurative programme of quadrupeds in profile, birds, a small human-like figure and a row of arched motifs arranged in stacked registers, while B contains no figures or creatures at all, only allover abstract patterning.
